name: BMMR2 Challenge
description: A challenge benchmarking algorithms that predict neoadjuvant chemotherapy response from multiparametric breast MRI data.
reputation: A domain-specific clinical challenge recognized in the medical imaging community for benchmarking MRI-based therapy response prediction, used primarily by research groups in oncology imaging.
notes: Clinical imaging challenge with limited sample sizes and potential site/scanner variability; careful cross-site validation required. Not an LLM benchmark and may risk overfitting if training/validation splits are not strictly separated by patient/site.
